title: Paraty Brazil by UTMB 2026: quem venceu a PTR 108 — Somos Trail
claims: Rogério Silvestrin won the 2026 PTR 108 in 12:43:38, 38 seconds ahead of Rodrigo Machado Oliveira (12:44:16); Paulo Galvao was third in 13:20:53.
Juliana Stolarski Uavnizack won the women's PTR 108 in 15:55:53; Mariana Scarpelli was second in 16:38:38 and Lilian Schiffer third in 17:41:58; all six podium finishers were Brazilian.

The organiser measured the 2026 PTR 108 at 101.9 km with 4,778 m of gain; the race started at 19:00 on Friday from the historic centre, and a finish under 26 hours gives access to the Western States lottery.

The 2026 edition was the fourth edition and the first with Nubank as naming-rights partner; the organiser described it as the country's first cardio-protected trail race with 30 AEDs across the course and medical posts.
